The '''Sand Crown of Ruul''' was a significant artifact of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruul (planet)|Ruul]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Vodran pirate crew|pirate crew]] of [[Vodran/Legends|Vodrans]] stole the crown.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Crown of Sand}}</ref>
